'''Falovan''' was a professional [[expeditor]] working on [[Revkinn V]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He could be hired for a 300-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] fee and, in a few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], Falovan discovered public information on the individual he had been asked to research.
